notes: REF-BM-05: no DELETE route, no store.delete method, no delete UI action — deletion not realised. REF-BM-14: search is plain lowercased substring over joined fields; no '#tag' syntax (tags stored without '#', so '#x' never matches). REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised-group parsing; query treated as one literal substring. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling; quotes are matched literally. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/API at all. REF-BM-21: no bulk-apply-to-filter capability. REF-BM-23: notes can be written/stored and displayed, but rendered as escaped plain text via esc()/hl() — no markdown rendering. REF-BM-24: no snapshot feature (no HTML capture, no PDF rule). REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-27: archive is reversible (Restore) but delete does not exist, so the archive-vs-permanent-delete distinction is only half realised. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity or persistence. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no user-settings persistence (sort is transient client state; no displayed-items or font-size setting).
